header_sentences: See Confasciculation, also see Bind, and Sheaf.

contexts.text: At last spiritual goods and truths are gathered as it were into bundles...
They who have held the communion of wives as a principle... are gathered as it were into a bundle...
These arrangings into order are signified in the Word by bundles...

The scientifics and truths in man's memory... cohere fascicularly, and the bundles do so with each other; and this according to the connexion of things which the man had taken up... The scientifics and truths are arranged in these fascicular forms by the man's loves...
Ye shall take a bunch of hyssop ()... A bunch is predicated of truths and their arrangement.
I saw... many gathered into congregations, as it were into bundles, according to the genera and species of evil, and cast into (these) Hells.
The doctrines of the modern Church are bundled together by means of many paradoxes...
... and all these paradoxes are bundled together as it were into one bundle...

Evils are bound into bundles by falsities, and goods are bound into bundles by truths; and as there are such bindings together of goods and of evils, the Lord says that the tares are to be bound into bundles for burning, and all things that offend.
The abundance of truths cohering as it were in a bundle, exalts and perfects faith. General article.
The arrangement of the truths of faith is into series, thus as it were into bundles. General article.
